editorial.archiveTitle: 日报｜《Cairn》免费DLC首弹10月29日上线

decisions.headline: 《Cairn》免费DLC首弹“Deep Water”定于10月29日上线
decisions.summary: The Game Bakers公布《Cairn》免费DLC系列“On the Trail”首弹“Deep Water”，计划10月29日推出。两家报道一致确认该内容加入3个攀爬区域与“Water Solo”模式；该模式的岩壁下方为水面，失足不会造成坠落伤害。
decisions.verification: 已打开AUTOMATON与电Fami两家独立媒体报道；两者一致确认DLC名称、10月29日日期及新增区域与模式。
decisions.reason: 两家独立可靠媒体对窗口内DLC发布日期和核心新增内容形成交叉核验。
decisions.timeNote: 以两家已打开报道中较早的发布时间换算为北京时间。

decisions.headline: 怪异清洁模拟游戏《Dust till Dawn》公布，计划2027年登陆PC
decisions.summary: Mac n Cheese Games公布《Dust till Dawn》。玩家在虚构的日本乡村从事清洁工作，工作拖到夜间可提高报酬，也会增加遭遇超常现象的概率；作品计划2027年登陆Steam，并以伊藤润二作品为灵感。
decisions.verification: 已打开AUTOMATON与电Fami两家独立媒体报道；两者一致确认作品公布、PC平台、清洁玩法与超常现象设定。
decisions.reason: 两家独立可靠媒体对窗口内新作公布及核心玩法形成交叉核验。
decisions.timeNote: 以两家已打开报道中较早的发布时间换算为北京时间。

decisions.verification: 已按本包已打开证据完成编辑判断。
decisions.reason: 第二个所谓独立来源实际是窗口外的BlizzCon汇总，无法支持本条PC Gaming Show汇总。

decisions.titleEn: Lufia I & II: The Sinistrals Saga
decisions.headline: 《Lufia I & II: The Sinistrals Saga》公布，计划2027年发售
decisions.summary: Taito公布《Lufia I & II: The Sinistrals Saga》，将系列前两作经部分翻新后合辑移植，并加入提升易用性的功能。作品计划2027年登陆PS5、Nintendo Switch 2、Nintendo Switch与PC。
decisions.verification: 已打开AUTOMATON报道；正文明确列出发行方、合辑性质、目标平台与2027年窗口，尚未打开一手公告。
decisions.reason: 窗口内可靠媒体报道提供了明确的新作公布与平台信息。
decisions.timeNote: 按AUTOMATON页面发布时间换算为北京时间。

versionsAndTerms: Lufia I & II: The Sinistrals Saga

decisions.headline: 《Dream Club ZERO R+》公布，计划2027年发售
decisions.summary: D3 Publisher公布《Dream Club ZERO R+》。报道将其描述为2011年《Dream Club ZERO》的移植版本，并确认新增3名陪酒女郎；具体平台和“R+”所代表的追加内容尚未公布。
decisions.verification: 已打开AUTOMATON报道；正文明确确认公布、2027年窗口与3名新增角色，同时保留平台及“R+”含义未定的边界。
decisions.reason: 窗口内可靠媒体报道提供明确的新作公布与新增角色信息。
decisions.timeNote: 按AUTOMATON页面发布时间换算为北京时间。

decisions.verification: 已按本包已打开证据完成编辑判断。
decisions.reason: 仅为每周折扣选编，缺少已打开官方商店证据且价格高度时效，不作为本期独立新闻。

decisions.verification: 已按本包已打开证据完成编辑判断。
decisions.reason: 这是媒体每周文章汇总，混合多个既有条目，未提供可安全独立发布的单一新增事实。

decisions.headline: 《Escape from Playtime》定于10月21日开启Steam抢先体验
decisions.summary: IGN报道，《Poppy Playtime》合作生存恐怖衍生作《Escape from Playtime》将于10月21日在Steam开启抢先体验。玩家扮演被困于Playtime Co.工厂的Smiling Critters，通过解谜、躲藏与近距离语音协作逃生。
decisions.verification: 已打开IGN报道；正文明确给出10月21日Steam抢先体验日期及合作逃生玩法，尚未打开一手公告。
decisions.reason: 窗口内可靠媒体报道提供明确的抢先体验日期与玩法信息。
decisions.timeNote: 按IGN页面发布时间换算为北京时间。

decisions.headline: 潜行高尔夫游戏《Really Illegal Golf》公布，计划2027年第一季度登陆PC
decisions.summary: No More Robots公布Pushlab Games开发的《Really Illegal Golf》。玩家潜入禁止进入的球场，在警卫、摄像头与无人机监视下打球；作品支持单人、在线合作和对战，计划2027年第一季度登陆Steam，试玩版现已提供。
decisions.verification: 已打开AUTOMATON报道；正文明确列出发行商、开发商、PC平台、2027年第一季度窗口及多人模式，尚未打开一手公告。
decisions.reason: 窗口内可靠媒体报道提供了明确的新作公布与玩法信息。
decisions.timeNote: 按AUTOMATON页面发布时间换算为北京时间。

decisions.headline: 《BALL x PIT》扩展包“Risen Ballbylon”公布，11月6日推出
decisions.summary: Gematsu报道，Devolver Digital与开发者Kenny Sun公布《BALL x PIT》扩展包“Risen Ballbylon”，计划11月6日推出，定价6.99美元。已打开证据未明确扩展包的具体平台范围。
decisions.verification: 已打开Gematsu报道；正文明确确认扩展包名称、11月6日日期与6.99美元定价，平台范围未据此扩张。
decisions.reason: 窗口内可靠媒体报道提供明确的扩展包发布日期与价格。
decisions.timeNote: 按Gematsu页面发布时间换算为北京时间。

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Cairn’s first free DLC launches October 29

entries.headline: Cairn’s first free DLC launches October 29
entries.summary: The Game Bakers’ On the Trail: Deep Water adds three climbing areas and the Water Solo mode, where falling into water avoids injury.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON and Denfaminicogamer independently agree on the DLC name, date and core additions.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time uses the earlier opened report’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Paranormal cleaning game Dust till Dawn announced for PC
entries.summary: Mac n Cheese Games’ cleaning simulation is set in a fictional Japanese village, where working later raises both rewards and the risk of paranormal encounters. It is planned for 2027.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON and Denfaminicogamer independently confirm the announcement, PC platform and core premise.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time uses the earlier opened report’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Lufia I & II: The Sinistrals Saga announced for 2027
entries.summary: Taito is bringing the first two Lufia games together in a partially renewed collection for PS5, Switch 2, Switch and PC.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report provides the collection format, platforms and 2027 window; no primary announcement was opened.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time is converted from AUTOMATON’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Dream Club ZERO R+ announced for 2027
entries.summary: D3 Publisher announced a port of the 2011 game with three new hostesses. Platforms and the exact meaning of R+ remain unannounced.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report confirms the announcement, 2027 window and three added characters.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time is converted from AUTOMATON’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Escape from Playtime enters Steam Early Access on October 21
entries.summary: The Poppy Playtime co-op survival-horror spinoff casts players as Smiling Critters escaping the Playtime Co. factory through puzzles, stealth and proximity-chat teamwork.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report states the October 21 Steam Early Access date and the co-op premise.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time is converted from IGN’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Really Illegal Golf announced for PC
entries.summary: The stealth-golf game asks players to sneak onto barred courses while evading guards, cameras and drones. It supports solo, online co-op and competitive play and is planned for Q1 2027.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report confirms the publisher, developer, PC platform, release window and multiplayer modes.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time is converted from AUTOMATON’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: BALL x PIT expansion Risen Ballbylon launches November 6
entries.summary: Devolver Digital and Kenny Sun announced the expansion at $6.99. The opened evidence does not establish the expansion’s platform list.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report confirms the expansion name, November 6 date and $6.99 price.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time is converted from Gematsu’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Honkai: Star Rail version 4.6 launches September 28
entries.summary: Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise advances the Astropolis story and adds the five-star Ice Elation character Pearl alongside new events.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report states the developer, version title, September 28 date and key additions.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time is converted from Gematsu’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Industrial-noir RPG WANE announced for PC
entries.summary: Shoreline Games and Metis Creative announced a grid-based turn-based RPG in which Declan Wayne leads a three-person party through three biomes. No release date was announced.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report confirms the publisher, developer, PC platform and gameplay loop.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time is converted from Gematsu’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Megami Ibunroku Persona soundtrack launches September 21
entries.summary: Atlus announced that the original soundtrack would arrive on music streaming services at midnight Japan time, marking the first game’s 30th anniversary.
entries.verification: Famitsu and Denfaminicogamer independently confirm the soundtrack and launch time; Denfaminicogamer explicitly attributes the announcement to Atlus.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time uses Denfaminicogamer’s timestamp; the launch time itself is midnight Japan time.
